lines.meet: My name's Marco. I'm a locksmith, and here I stand in front of people, so you go where you need to go and I'll be in front of you.
lines.meet_neighbour: We're both in the Undercity, I think, off the Trade Quarter. I'm Marco, with the tools on the windowsill.
lines.ask_home: Where do your people come from, {ragazzo|ragazza}? Tell me about them.
lines.ask_work: Your trade, before? A man should know what the people beside him can do.
lines.answer_home: Naples, the Quartieri Spagnoli, the narrow streets above Via Toledo. My father mended shoes there.
lines.answer_work: I was a locksmith for thirty-one years, with my own shop and a door that was always open.
lines.chat_food: A good coffee in the morning, standing at the bar, in one go. That's the whole of Naples in a cup.
lines.chat_sleep: Old men sleep badly, and I'm an old man. I wake at five and lie there listening to the street.
lines.chat_missing: A street where everybody knows each other. Here I'm learning the Forsaken one by one.
lines.chat_here: I looked for people to be useful to in my first fortnight here. That's what I do, I find out what's broken.
lines.tease_quiet: You're as quiet as me, {name}. Between us, we'll say about ten words a day.
lines.tease_talker: You talk like my wife, {name}, and I love my wife, so I'll allow it.
lines.tease_careful: You test a lock before you touch it, {name}. You'd have been a good apprentice.
lines.tease_bold: You kick the door before you've tried the handle, {name}. Every time, I've watched you.
lines.tease_any: You remind me of my apprentice, {name}, stubborn and good. Don't tell him I said so.
lines.tease_back: Ha, you got me, {name}. Very good, {ragazzo|ragazza}.
lines.take_it_kindly: You're right, {name}, and Carmela would have told me first.
lines.bristle: Not that, {name}. I'll stand for a lot, but not that.
lines.apologise: Scusa, I spoke badly. That's not how I should talk to anyone.
lines.double_down: Once said, it stays said. I'm too old to take things back.
lines.needle_quiet: Something's broken and you won't say what. I can't fix what I'm not shown.
lines.needle_talker: You talk too much and listen too little, {ragazzo|ragazza}. Try it the other way.
lines.needle_careful: You've stood at that door long enough. Some locks you just open.
lines.needle_bold: You show off in front of everyone, and somebody else pays for it. I've seen it all my life.
lines.needle_any: You make promises and you don't keep them. I can't abide that.
lines.bite_back: I've stood in front of people my whole life and never asked for thanks. Don't tell me I'm not doing enough.
lines.hurt: Hm, that was heavy. I'll carry it a while and see.
lines.laugh_off: My wife said worse every morning for forty years, {ragazzo|ragazza}. Andiamo, let's go on.
lines.confide: {name}, I held my grandson four times before all this. Four, I counted. I think about that more than I'd say.
lines.listen: I'll keep it, {name}, like a key that only opens one door.
lines.look_out: Behind me in there, {name}. That's where you stay.
lines.accept: Va bene, {name}, we'll do it your way.
lines.deflect: A stuck door's hurt me worse, {name}. Look after the young ones.
lines.check_in: Let me see, {name}. Where is it, and how bad?
lines.blame: Somebody didn't wait, and we all paid. I'll say no more, but I saw.
lines.thank: I owe you my life now, {ragazzo|ragazza}, and I pay my debts.
lines.brush_off: It's nothing, it needed doing. Sit a moment.
lines.worry: Sit down, {name}, slowly. My heart's not as young as it was.
lines.handed_down: Yours, I think, before it was mine. I'll keep it oiled, like a good lock.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, {ragazzo|ragazza}, it's yours now. An old man needs very little.
lines.hand_sulk: A man likes to be asked. Nobody asked me.
lines.turn_friendly: I'd let you mind the shop, {name}. That's trust, in Naples.
lines.turn_friends: You'd have a key to my door, {name}, if I still had a door. That's what family means to me.
lines.turn_grating: We don't fit together, you and I, like the wrong key. That's all right.
lines.turn_rivals: Everyone gets me in front of them, you included. Don't mistake it for more.
lines.make_up: Basta, {name}, enough. We start again, like men of sense.
lines.defend: No, that's wrong, and I saw it. You'll leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: The door's quieter without {name} coming through it, and I notice it.
lines.friend_back: Ah, {name}, you've come home. Good, come in.
lines.common_locks: Thirty-one years of opening doors for people who'd locked themselves out of their lives. Another locksmith knows the real job is listening.
lines.common_italian: You speak Italian! Finalmente, {ragazzo|ragazza}, where from? Tell me, and I'll tell you what's wrong with it.
lines.common_parent: Two girls, Giulia and Sara, and a grandson, Matteo, born the February before all this. That's my whole wealth.
